step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram represents Korean Air's Data Warehouse Modernization and CI/CD Pipeline. The visual entities from the world model include Oracle on EC2, DMS, RDS, S3, Glue, Redshift, Athena, CodePipeline, CodeCommit, CodeBuild, and CloudFormation. In the data processing flow, continuous change data capture (CDC) flows from Oracle on EC2 via AWS DMS, replicating data to PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS and archiving change history to Amazon S3. For analytics, AWS Glue extracts data from RDS and S3 to perform ETL processing before loading into Amazon Redshift, while Athena enables direct querying against S3. On the CI/CD front, CodePipeline orchestrates code management through CodeCommit, builds via CodeBuild, and automates multi-account infrastructure deployment using CloudFormation.

graph.name: Korean Air Data Warehouse Modernization Architecture
graph.notes: Korean Air modernized its enterprise data warehouse by migrating legacy operational database workloads to AWS using DMS, RDS, S3, Glue, Redshift, and Athena, supported by a dedicated CI/CD pipeline.

nodes.name: Oracle on EC2
nodes.notes: Source database running Oracle on EC2 containing operational reservation, ticketing, and flight data.

nodes.name: DMS
nodes.notes: AWS Database Migration Service used for continuous change data capture (CDC) replication.

nodes.name: RDS
nodes.notes: Target database running PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS, converted using AWS Schema Conversion Tool (SCT).

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Stores database change history at low cost, serving as the core repository for the data lake.

nodes.name: Glue
nodes.notes: Executes ETL processing jobs to transform and load data from RDS and S3 into Redshift.

nodes.name: Redshift
nodes.notes: Enterprise data warehouse hosting fact and dimension tables for BI reporting and executive dashboards.

nodes.name: Athena
nodes.notes: Serverless interactive query service used to analyze data directly in Amazon S3.

nodes.name: CodePipeline
nodes.notes: Orchestrates end-to-end automation for Glue code management and environment deployments.

nodes.name: CodeCommit
nodes.notes: Version control repository for Glue ETL scripts and configuration files.

nodes.name: CodeBuild
nodes.notes: Builds and tests Glue ETL script updates and deployment packages.

nodes.name: CloudFormation
nodes.notes: Deploys infrastructure and code artifacts automatically across DEV and PRD accounts.

edges.notes: DMS performs real-time CDC extraction from the operational Oracle DB on EC2.
DMS replicates operational changes to PostgreSQL on RDS within seconds to 3 minutes.
DMS writes historical change tracking logs into S3.
Athena queries raw historical data directly from S3.
Glue extracts structured relational data from RDS for ETL transformation.
Glue extracts data history from S3 for ETL transformation.
Glue loads transformed dimension and fact datasets into Amazon Redshift.
CodePipeline monitors and triggers on source changes in CodeCommit.
CodeCommit triggers CodeBuild to process script validation and build.
CodeBuild passes build outputs to CloudFormation for multi-account deployment.
